title: ARTEX abuse expands as cybercriminals target financial sector
contentSnippet:
In October 2026, the financially motivated threat actor Storm-3358 began targeting organizations in the financial sector using the agentic AI offensive framework ARTEX.
The post ARTEX abuse expands as cybercriminals target financial sector appeared first on Microsoft Security Blog.

title: Beyond code generation: A developer’s guide to agentic engineering
contentSnippet:
Writing code got faster. The work around it didn't. See how you can plan, write code, review changes, and investigate production issues with GitHub Copilot, and what work still needs your judgment.
The post Beyond code generation: A developer’s guide to agentic engineering appeared first on The GitHub Blog.
